title: cystopteris myrrhidifolia
intro: Cystopteris myrrhidifolia, commonly known as the bladder fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. The bladder fern has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris myrrhidifolia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
